title: melicope lohiauana
intro: Melicope lohiauana, commonly known as the Maui foreri, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It is a shrub native to the island of Maui in Hawaii, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Melicope lohiauana include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, limonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions like antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
